change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: `config` with display schedule_type is computed but never used
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds `config` with `schedule_type` replaced by its display value (lines 160-162). The returned dict then uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (line 168), so the copy is dead. The raw `schedule_type` value ends up in the occurrence's event context. This code was moved unchanged from `mark_failed.py`, so the bug is not new. Since the function is being relocated, it would be a good time to return `config` (line 168), or drop the copy if the raw value is intended. Other serializers use the display value: see `src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242`.

findings.title: Docstring has a typo and an example the code cannot produce
findings.body: "humam readible" should be "human readable". The examples list "A failed check-in was detected", but the code returns "A missed/error/timeout check-in was detected" (lines 124-126). The plural example also does not match the "%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected" format at line 156. This was moved unchanged, so it is optional cleanup.

contracts.action: Move of mark_failed_threshold to try_incident_threshold (renamed) and of create_issue_platform_occurrence to create_incident_occurrence (renamed), plus failure-reason helpers, into new modules
contracts.equivalent_path: Old mark_failed_threshold and create_issue_platform_occurrence in src/sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py (removed in this diff)
contracts.before_after: The function body is identical to the removed one. Before the call, mark_failed.py:63-76 still runs the guarded update of last_checkin/next_checkin and the refresh_from_db. After it, the result is returned (mark_failed.py:79). Only the names and module changed. The local imports of `monitor_environment_failed`, `IssueOccurrence` and `produce_occurrence_to_kafka` are kept.
contracts.visible_effect: None. The same incident, occurrence and signal are produced as before.
contracts.failure_mode: A leftover importer of the removed names would raise ImportError. A repo-wide grep finds no remaining references to mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence (monitors) or the moved helpers. The remaining importers (monitor_consumer.py:33, check_timeout.py:9, check_missed.py:11, and the tests) only import `mark_failed`. The uptime function with the same name is separate (src/sentry/uptime/issue_platform.py:16).

contracts.before_after: The definition is the same. types.py already imports `datetime` and `TypedDict` (lines 4 and 6), so there is no new import and no import cycle through models.

summary: This is a behaviour-preserving refactor. It moves the incident threshold and occurrence logic out of mark_failed.py into incidents.py and incident_occurrence.py, and moves SimpleCheckIn into types.py. Two functions are renamed in the move: `mark_failed_threshold` becomes `try_incident_threshold`, and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` becomes `create_incident_occurrence`. No references to the old names remain, and the local imports are preserved. I found no regressions. Two carried-over nits are noted as optional: an unused `config` variable in `get_monitor_environment_context`, and the `get_failure_reason` docstring. I did not build or run anything.
